note:
Three changes.

1. HERO REORDER + NEW MIDDLE SLIDE. Malcolm asked to open on the woman-model image rather than the product, and to make the middle an ingredient/science close-up after Tatcha. Tatcha's slideshow was captured and runs exactly that order: Brand-Main (model), Brand-Hadasei3 (ingredient), Brand-SkinMind (science). New order here is model -> science -> product, so the pure portrait leaves the hero and the laboratory-glass still life takes the middle. Tatcha's ingredient slide is stacked lab dishes holding the named actives, bright white, botanicals in the liquid; this is the same construction rendered dark to match slides 1 and 3, with copper and tinted solution instead of plants — botanicals stay barred because leaves argue against a peptide brand.
   content_max_width is measured per slide, never inherited. Clear zones: slide 1 to 38% (460px box), slide 2 to 56% (720), slide 3 to 59% (560, chosen to break after the first sentence — 'Premium Peptides.' measures 481px, adding 'Visible' takes it to 663px).

2. REVIEW SECTION. Malcolm asked to drop the product card and put the review text there at a larger size, as Tatcha does. shop-the-look cannot — the product card is its entire purpose — so this moves to media-with-text: image one side, text the other. The quote goes in `title` so it renders at heading size, with the rating and reviewer name in `subheading` above it, matching Tatcha's hierarchy. The product link survives as the section's text link instead of a card.

3. BOTTOM BRAND BANNER. Tatcha closes its homepage with a full-width brand-story band above the footer. Added as image-with-text-overlay using the portrait displaced from the hero, so an approved image is redeployed rather than discarded and the homepage gains a closing brand moment. Link verified: the philosophy page handle is /pages/our-philosophy, not /pages/philosophy.
